component.name: Capture
component.summary: Capture, crop and annotate your screen
Capture, recorte e anote a tela

description.p: Press Print, select what you want, and the image is already copied and saved. If you want, mark it up before pasting it somewhere else.

ul.li: Five capture modes: rectangle, window, full screen, free form and scrolling
Optional 3, 5 or 10 second delay
Works with multiple monitors
Editor with pen, highlighter, eraser, shapes, arrows, text and crop
Pixelate sensitive areas, rotate and resize
Each capture opens in a tab; join all tabs into one PDF
Screen recording (region, window or full screen) exported as MP4 or GIF
Capture history sidebar with optional daily list cleanup and private mode
Save as PNG, JPEG or PDF
Every capture is copied to the clipboard and saved as PNG automatically
Dark and light themes

description.p: Aperte Print, selecione o que quer, e a imagem já fica copiada e salva. Se quiser, marque por cima antes de colar em outro lugar.

ul.li: Cinco modos de captura: retângulo, janela, tela cheia, forma livre e rolável
Atraso opcional de 3, 5 ou 10 segundos
Funciona com mais de um monitor
Editor com caneta, marca-texto, borracha, formas, setas, texto e corte
Pixele áreas sensíveis, gire e redimensione
Cada captura abre numa aba; junte todas as abas num PDF
Gravação de tela (região, janela ou tela inteira) em MP4 ou GIF
Histórico num painel lateral, com limpeza diária da lista e modo anônimo
Salve em PNG, JPEG ou PDF
Toda captura é copiada para a área de transferência e salva em PNG automaticamente
Temas escuro e claro

description.p: O Capture precisa de uma sessão X11.
Cleaner interface: a discreet red REC button with an MP4 or GIF menu, better spacing in the header and compact, browser-style tabs.
Scrolling capture for web pages and long windows, automatically scrolling and stitching frames into a single image.
Screen recording for a region, window or full screen, exported as MP4 or GIF, with a live timer and a stop button placed outside the recorded area.
Sidebar with capture history (reopen in a new tab, copy, open folder or remove), optional daily list cleanup, and private mode.
Fixes the dark theme in the Flatpak version: the theme is now read from the desktop settings portal.
The Flatpak version now follows the dark theme of the desktop instead of always opening light.
Fixes stripes of the desktop wallpaper appearing in some captures. Full-screen capture is also about ten times faster on large screens.
Captures open in tabs, and all tabs can be joined into a single PDF. Save as PNG, JPEG or PDF. New pixelate tool, rotate and resize.
First release as a Flatpak, with everything included: no extra programs to install.
First release: rectangle, window, full screen and free form capture, with an annotation editor.
